text.text_excerpt: New Orleans is full of different burlesque shows, troupes and acts. In a sea of traditional burlesque, the Dirty Dime Peepshow stands out. Bella Blue is the producer and she never disappoints. Edgy and fun, the Dirty Dime features seasoned performers, as well as new talent. It is so much fun, and if you are a Burlesque "virgin", you will definitely cut your teeth quickly here.

New Orleans is a great city for burlesque. Several different groups perform shows on a fairly regular basis. So far I have seen three different shows. All were very different, but entertaining. The Dirty Dime involved several different acts, but one really stood out. The act involved a performer and a pole. It was the most physically demanding performance of the night, and her athleticism was very impressive. This was not some cheesy strip club pole act, but more a display of the performer's strength. I was amazed at what she was able to do. Other acts involved a Silence of the Lambs act, fire dancing, sword play and even a special birthday surprise for lucky birthday boys and girls. Anot...

Some of the best burlesque that this country has to offer. On any given Peepshow performance you can see critically acclaimed entertainers from all over the US. This is not your grandmas burlesque show. The boundaries of normal and sexy are pushed to the limits in the most erotic way. You can see sideshow acts along with classic acts along with neo acts and contortionists that will leave you both highly aroused and sometimes questioning life decisions. I never ever miss a Dirty Dime Peepshow and I highly suggest you don't either. Leave your preconceived notions of burlesque at the door and sit down with a drink for the experience of your life.
